mapper.select: SELECT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.product_status, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn, p.sale_start_date, p.sale_end_date, d.subtitle, d.content, d.image_url FROM TB_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION d ON p.product_no = d.product_no WHERE p.product_status = 'SALE' AND p.product_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS') ORDER BY p.product_no DESC

SELECT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.sale_start_date, p.sale_end_date, p.product_status, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn,
d.subtitle, d.content, d.eligibility_desc, d.period_desc, d.amount_desc, d.preferential_rate_summary, d.product_feature_desc, d.deposit_subject_desc, d.payment_method_desc, d.join_method_desc, d.required_document_desc, d.tax_benefit_desc, d.interest_rate_desc, d.interest_payment_desc, d.preferential_rate_desc, d.expected_interest_desc, d.caution_note, d.reference_note, d.sale_period_desc, d.non_taxable_savings_desc, d.disclosure_approval_desc, d.image_url,
c.min_age, c.max_age, c.customer_type, c.tax_benefit_yn, c.depositor_protection_yn, c.min_join_amount, c.max_join_amount, c.deposit_unit, c.min_term_months, c.max_term_months, c.fixed_term_yn, c.fixed_term_values, c.condition_note
FROM TB_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION d ON p.product_no = d.product_no LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_CONDITION c ON p.product_no = c.product_no WHERE p.product_no = #{product_no} AND p.product_status = 'SALE' AND p.product_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS')

WITH search_keyword AS ( SELECT normalized_keyword AS keyword FROM tb_keyword WHERE input_keyword = #{keyword} AND use_yn = 'Y' ) SELECT DISTINCT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.product_status, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn, p.sale_start_date, p.sale_end_date, d.subtitle, d.content, d.image_url FROM TB_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION d ON p.product_no = d.product_no WHERE p.product_status = 'SALE' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM search_keyword sk WHERE p.product_name LIKE '%' || sk.keyword || '%' OR d.content LIKE '%' || sk.keyword || '%' ) ORDER BY p.product_no

SELECT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn,
d.join_method_desc,
c.min_join_amount, c.max_join_amount, c.deposit_unit, c.min_term_months, c.max_term_months, c.fixed_term_yn, c.fixed_term_values, c.condition_note, c.depositor_protection_yn,
MAX(CASE WHEN r.rate_group = 'MATURITY' THEN r.rate_label END) AS maturity_rate_label,
MAX(CASE WHEN r.rate_group = 'MATURITY' THEN r.annual_rate END) AS maturity_annual_rate,
MAX(CASE WHEN r.rate_group = 'MATURITY' THEN r.annual_return_rate END) AS maturity_return_rate,
MAX(CASE WHEN r.rate_group = 'AFTER_MATURITY' THEN r.rate_label END) AS after_maturity_rate_label,
MAX(CASE WHEN r.rate_group = 'AFTER_MATURITY' THEN r.annual_rate END) AS after_maturity_annual_rate,
MAX(CASE WHEN r.rate_group = 'EARLY_TERMINATION' THEN r.rate_label END) AS early_rate_label,
MAX(CASE WHEN r.rate_group = 'EARLY_TERMINATION' THEN r.annual_rate END) AS early_annual_rate
FROM TB_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION d ON p.product_no = d.product_no LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_CONDITION c ON p.product_no = c.product_no LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_RATE r ON p.product_no = r.product_no AND r.use_yn = 'Y'
WHERE p.product_status = 'SALE' AND p.product_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS') AND p.product_no IN
#{product_no}
GROUP BY p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn, d.join_method_desc, c.min_join_amount, c.max_join_amount, c.deposit_unit, c.min_term_months, c.max_term_months, c.fixed_term_yn, c.fixed_term_values, c.condition_note, c.depositor_protection_yn
ORDER BY p.product_no

SELECT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.product_status, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn, p.sale_start_date, p.sale_end_date, d.subtitle, d.content, d.image_url FROM TB_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION d ON p.product_no = d.product_no JOIN TB_PRODUCT_CONDITION c ON p.product_no = c.product_no WHERE p.product_status = 'SALE' AND p.product_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS') AND ( c.customer_type = 'ALL' OR c.customer_type = #{memberType} ) ORDER BY p.product_no DESC

SELECT DISTINCT p.product_no, p.product_name, p.product_type, p.min_interest_rate, p.max_interest_rate, p.interest_payment_type, p.interest_calc_type, p.product_status, p.branch_join_yn, p.internet_join_yn, p.mobile_join_yn, p.sale_start_date, p.sale_end_date, d.subtitle, d.content, d.image_url FROM TB_PRODUCT p LEFT JOIN TB_PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION d ON p.product_no = d.product_no JOIN TB_PRODUCT_CONDITION c ON p.product_no = c.product_no LEFT JOIN TB_KEYWORD k ON ( p.product_name LIKE '%' || k.normalized_keyword || '%' OR d.content LIKE '%' || k.normalized_keyword || '%' OR d.subtitle LIKE '%' || k.normalized_keyword || '%' ) WHERE p.product_status = 'SALE' AND p.product_type IN ('DEPOSIT', 'SAVINGS') AND ( c.customer_type = 'ALL' OR c.customer_type = #{memberType} ) AND ( p.product_name LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.content LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR d.subtitle LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR k.input_keyword LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR k.normalized_keyword LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' ) ORDER BY p.product_no DESC
